incidents.name: TGC helper unprotected buy/sell entry points
incidents.notes: The unverified TGC helper exposes unauthenticated entry points (selectors 0x836aefb0 and 0xfd5a466f) that move the helper's TGC and USDT through the pair, which the attacker drove from inside a PancakeSwap swap callback.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x32F9188d6D86Bf88dbAc3ceEe5958aDf1aa609df created 2024-05-09T19:13:06Z by 0x35a4f4e2b372fd76c0d5e969bd977f4a4683e11e, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x36fb87c3e65ec608d37e38bd556fb6ebdb3d8a39; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
